forum.title: STM32L433CCY6TR Pin Count Confirmation
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Noam\_MSI ;

The C" refer to 48 pins /49 pins in Pin count and "Y "refer to WLCSP.

These typos will be corrected in the coming datasheet version.

Thank you.

Kaouthar
forum.content_text:
Hi.

For our footprint definition we require a confirmation from you:

1. The letter ‘C’ in the Pin Count ordering information is used for both 48 and 49 pins packages.

2. The WLCSP package is 49 pins.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0f2fa450-0412-4e0b-a18d-ac66ff8992c7.png)

Thanks in advance,

Noam
